Messages.Author: Simcof
Messages.Body:
does a minion have to be untapped to use their specials if it does not
require tapping, e.g. quentins vote canceling

my gut instinct is no, since i don't believe it is a "reaction" (i
couldn't seem to find anything about specials being
reactions/modifiers where appropriate)

cheers
Ben Szymkow

Messages.Author: the_capuchin
Messages.Body:


And they're not, so you can use Quentin's special, yes. In fact, you
can use it even when he's in torpor since cardtext do not explicit say
"while Quentin is ready etc". Maybe we're playing wrong, but we assume
that as some specials say "while John Doe is ready" (Toreador Bart's
cardtext say "while he is ready and untapped"), that means any special
could be used by a vampire who is in play, in torpor or not, unless
his cardtext says otherwise.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct.

Too often people forget that she's capable of tapping in torpor since
it's not an action. That's why you *must* untap torporized vampires in
your untap phase, even if you do not intend to rescue them ;-)

My own Marciana is always inserted on my Assamite crypts just for this
(and sometimes to be an easy acess to Deflections, if the crypt is
made with Badr al Budur). I'd love to have 3 of her.
